parse.title: Dead Adventurer
parse.wikitext:
{{Event Header|Event-DeadAdventurer.png}} {{E|Dead Adventurer}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 1]]. ==Options== {{Frame|Search}} {{TS|positive||Find Loot.}} {{TS|negative||25%}} {{Asc|15|(35%)}}{{TS|negative||: monster returns.}} * Each {{Frame|Search}} attempt will either cause an [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Act 1 Elite]] to return and fight the player, or yield one of the following rewards: ** 30 [[Gold]] ** A random [[Relic]] ** Nothing * Each reward only occurs once - if the player's first search found nothing and the second search found the [[Relic]], the third search will either reward 30 [[Gold]] or start a battle. * Each reward that is acquired before fighting the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] will be removed from its combat rewards if the player eventually does fight the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] and defeats it. ** For example, if the player's first {{Frame|Search}} is a [[Relic]], the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] will not drop a [[Relic]] when it is defeated. ** This is also the reason why this specific [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] fight can drop 30 extra [[Gold]] compared to a normal [[Elite]]; because the 30 [[Gold]] {{Frame|Search}} reward is added to the normal [[Gold]] reward of defeating an [[Elite]]. * Each subsequent {{Frame|Search}} increases the chance to encounter an [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] by 25%. * If the player manages to successfully {{Frame|Search}} three times without encountering an [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]], the event will end with a short dialogue detailing the success. * For the second and third searches (assuming the player is not ambushed), {{Frame|Search}} will be called {{Frame|Continue}} instead. Its behavior and description are unchanged.
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. ==Dialogue==
You come across a {{TS|negative||dead adventurer}} on the floor.
His {{TS|blue||pants}} have been stolen! Also, (phrasing depends on the Elite).
Though his {{TS|gold||possessions are still intact,}} you're in no mind to find out what happened here...


The phrasing on how the adventurer died depends on which [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] will be fought if a {{Frame|Search}} attempt fails: * '''For {{M|Gremlin Nob}}:''' Also, it looks as though he's been {{TS|negative|shake|gouged and trampled}} by a horned beast. * '''For {{M|Sentry|Sentries}}:''' Also, the armor and face appear to be {{TS|negative|shake|scoured by flames.}} * '''For {{M|Lagavulin}}:''' Also, he looks to have been {{TS|negative|shake|eviscerated and chopped}} by giant claws. ** {{M|Lagavulin}} during this event is particularly dangerous as it '''does not''' enter combat {{Int|Lagavulin|Sleep|Asleep}}. It also immediately debuffs the player with its {{Int|Lagavulin|Siphon Soul}} on the first turn of the fight.
{{Frame|Search}} (and {{Frame|Continue}} for the second and third searches)
If the player finds [[Gold]]:
You found some {{TS|gold||gold!}}
Continue searching?
The player is able to {{Frame|Continue}} searching with a +25% chance for the monster to return, or {{Frame|Leave}} and end the event.
If the player finds a [[Relic]]:
You found a {{TS|gold||relic!}}
Continue searching?
The player is able to {{Frame|Continue}} searching with a +25% chance for the monster to return, or {{Frame|Leave}} and end the event.
If the player finds nothing:
Hmm, couldn't find anything...
Continue searching?
The player is able to {{Frame|Continue}} searching with a +25% chance for the monster to return, or {{Frame|Leave}} and end the event.
If the player is ambushed by the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]]:
While searching the adventurer you are caught off guard!
{{Frame|Fight}} The player enters a fight with the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]]. The event ends with no additional dialogue after the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] is defeated.
If this is the third successful Search in a row:
Looks like you searched all his belongings without a hitch!
{{Frame|Leave}} The event ends with no additional dialogue.
{{Frame|Leave}}
You exit without a sound.
==Notes== * {{R|Black Star}} will not cause the [[Elite]] to drop an additional [[Relic]]. However, the other "elite relics" {{R|Preserved Insect}}, {{R|Sling of Courage}}, and {{R|Slaver's Collar}} will work as expected. * It is quite unlikely for the player to be able to {{Frame|Search}} three times without being ambushed since they must succeed on all three searches with increasing chances of failure. See the table below for more information: {| class="wikitable" |+ Cumulative Chance of Avoiding the Elite |- ! Number of Searches
(% chance of Elite returning) !! Before {{Asc|15}} !! {{Asc|15}} and Above |- | 1 (25% / {{Asc|15|35%}}) || 75% || 65% |- | 2 (50% / {{Asc|15|60%}}) || 37.5% || 26% |- | 3 (75% / {{Asc|15|85%}}) || 9.375% || 3.9% |} ==Trivia== * The image of the dead adventurer is called nopants.png internally. * {{E|Dead Adventurer}} is one of three possible ways to fight an [[Elite]] outside of an [[Map Locations#Elites|Elite floor]]; the others being {{E|The Colosseum}} (with {{M|Taskmaster}} and {{M|Gremlin Nob}}) and the [[Spheric_Guardian#Act_2|Act 2 fight]] with one {{M|Sentry}} and a {{M|Spheric Guardian}}. * {{E|Dead Adventurer}}'s {{M|Lagavulin}} is the only case where an [[Elite]] enemy has different behavior compared to its typical encounter on an [[Map Locations#Elites|Elite floor]]. ==Update History== * '''Weekly Patch 49: The Designer''' ** Fixed Dead Adventurer event was not giving the gold correctly (just showing the effect). * '''Weekly Patch 46: Adrenaline''' ** Preserved Insect and Sling should now work in all elite combats including elite battles from events (like dead adventurer event). * '''Weekly Patch 39: We Meet Again!''' ** Minor dialog improvement for Dead Adventurer event. * '''Weekly Patch 34: Malaise''' ** Gold gain effect from things like Dead Adventurer is now a localizeable string. * '''Weekly Patch 5: Happy Holidays!''' ** Fixed a new line character placed incorrectly for dead adventurer's event. * '''Weekly Patch 2: Slimes!''' ** Dead Adventurer event can now only appear on floor 7 and above. {{EventNav}} [[Category:Events]]
